title: Resume imports from a transactional checkpoint
prompt: Persist the importer's last committed batch in the existing SQLite database and resume from that checkpoint after restart. Write the checkpoint in the same transaction as the imported batch so a crash can neither skip nor duplicate rows.
objective: A restarted import continues after the last committed batch with exactly once row application.
context: The current importer starts from zero after a crash.
The user selected the existing SQLite database as the checkpoint location.
requirements: Store the checkpoint in the same transaction as each committed batch.
Read the latest checkpoint before selecting the first batch on startup.
Treat an absent checkpoint as a fresh import.
constraints: Do not introduce Redis or any new service.
acceptance_criteria: After a forced restart, the importer resumes after the last committed batch.
A crash before commit replays the whole uncommitted batch and produces exactly-once final rows.
A new import with no checkpoint retains the current first-run behavior.
assumptions: Each batch is already committed atomically.
